tags.name: Supply_&_Demand_–_Client_API_Grains S&D
tags.description:
Grains S&D

Kpler Grains Supply & Demand provides access to comprehensive grains market data including balance sheets of major grains exporters and detailed export breakdowns.

tags.name: Supply_&_Demand_–_Client_API_LNG & Gas S&D
tags.description:
LNG & Gas S&D

Kpler LNG & Gas Supply & Demand provides a forward-looking view of the global LNG market and the natural gas balances of the world's key gas economies. It combines a global LNG balance – grounded in Kpler's near-real-time vessel flows – with full supply, demand, and storage balances for the major markets that drive LNG trade, covering an 18-month rolling forecast at monthly resolution.

get.description: Retrieve supply and demand balances for LNG

parameters.name: zones
parameters.description: Zones/countries used to filter the results. Multiple values allowed. Defaults to [World] if not provided.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date of the period for which to retrieve balances, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date of the period for which to retrieve balances, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). For trial users, forecast data is limited to 3 months from the latest release date.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token of the page to retrieve

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Metrics to return. Defaults to [supply, demand, balancingFactor] if not provided.

parameters.name: splits
parameters.description: Data split to return. Defaults to total if not provided. Available values: total, requestedZones, country, lngRegion, lngSubRegion, continent, subcontinent, installation.

get.description: Retrieve supply and demand balances for natural gas

parameters.name: zones
parameters.description: Zones/countries used to filter the results. Multiple values allowed. Defaults to [World] if not provided.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date of the period for which to retrieve balances, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date of the period for which to retrieve balances, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). For trial users, forecast data is limited to 3 months from the latest release date.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token of the page to retrieve

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Metrics to return. Defaults to all gas metrics if not provided.

parameters.name: splits
parameters.description: Data splits to return. `fullBalance` (default) returns countries/regions where a complete balance is available (e.g. EU-27)  `country` returns metrics at the finest available granularity (individual countries or aggregate regions), even if a complete balance is not available. Only one of the two can be requested. Defaults to [fullBalance] if not provided.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Unit for returned values. `bcm` (default) returns metrics in billion cubic metres. `bcfd` returns flow metrics in billion cubic feet per day and storage level/capacity metrics in billion cubic feet (bcf), since they represent point-in-time volumes.
